definitions.short: Palti , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H6406. Palti II. מַּלְטִי proper name, masculine Φαλτει (perhaps abbreviated from מַּלְטִיאֵל ; — 1 Benjamite Num 13:9 . 2 second husband of Michal 1Sam 25:44 (= מַּלְטִיאֵל 2Sam 3:15 ).

occurrences.englishText: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.
